title: Window Rules
state.noLoader.title: The rule loader is not running
state.noLoader.body: Hyprland applies these rules through the plugin's loader. Add the load block from the plugin README (examples/hyprland.lua) at the end of ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua, then reload Hyprland.
state.empty: No rules yet. Capture a window or create a rule.
state.conflict.title: The rules changed elsewhere
state.conflict.body: Another panel or an editor saved the rules file after you opened it. Nothing was written; the current rules have been loaded.
state.invalid.title: The rules file cannot be used
state.invalid.body: The file is shown read-only until it is fixed or the last valid version is restored.
state.unsupported.title: The rules file is from a newer version
state.unsupported.body: This version of the plugin cannot edit it. Update the plugin to change these rules.
state.busyElsewhere: Another panel is saving the rules right now. Nothing was written; try again in a moment.
save.writeFailed: The rules file could not be written
save.savedNotReloaded: The rules were saved, but “%1” failed, so Hyprland may not apply them yet
save.tooManyRules: A rules file holds at most %1 rules; remove one first
save.tooLarge: The rules would take %1 bytes, more than the 1 MiB a rules file may hold
save.busy: A save is already in progress
save.noStateDir: The plugin's state directory could not be created, so nothing can be saved
save.notEditable: The rules file cannot be changed until it is fixed or restored
restore.none: There is no valid backup to restore
restore.changed: The rules file changed since it was shown; nothing was restored
capture.conflict: Reapply or discard your kept rule before capturing a window
confirm.changed: That rule changed or was removed meanwhile; nothing was deleted
list.full: A rules file holds at most %1 rules; remove one to add another
confirm.delete.title: Delete this rule?
confirm.delete.body: “%1” will be removed when you save.
confirm.discard.title: Discard your changes?
confirm.discard.body: The rule goes back to how it was last saved.
confirm.discardList.body: The list goes back to how it was last saved.
confirm.restore.title: Restore the last valid version?
confirm.restore.body: The current file is replaced by the backup taken at the last save.
confirm.replaceDraft.title: Replace the rule you are editing?
confirm.replaceDraft.body: The captured window takes the place of your unsaved rule.
confirm.discardConflict.body: Your rule is dropped and the rules stay as they are now.
field.name: Name
field.apps.add: An app without an open window can be added by its window class
field.apps.full: A rule matches at most %1 apps; remove one to add another
field.class: Window class, as a regular expression
field.title: Window title, as a regular expression
toggle.initial.hint: Match the class and title the window opened with
editor.repaired: This rule was not applied as written. Fields that could not be used were reset to their defaults; saving replaces the rule in the file.
loader.revisionMismatch: Hyprland loaded revision %1, but revision %2 was written
loader.versionMismatch: The loader in use is version %1 and the plugin is version %2; reinstall the plugin and reload Hyprland
loader.schemaOlder: The loader in use reads rules format %1, older than format %2 that this panel writes; reinstall the plugin and reload Hyprland
loader.apiNewer: The loader in use reports API %1, newer than the API %2 this panel knows; update the plugin
error.invalid-file: The rules file is not a valid rules document
error.unsupported-version: The rules file was written by a newer version of the plugin
error.invalid-revision: The rules file has an invalid revision
error.too-many-rules: The rules file has more than 200 rules
error.invalid-rule: This entry is not a rule
error.invalid-id: The identifier must be 1 to 48 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter or digit
error.duplicate-id: Another rule already uses this identifier
error.invalid-name: The name must be 1 to 80 characters without control characters
error.invalid-flag: An on/off setting has an invalid value
error.invalid-class: The window class is invalid: a rule matches 1 to 32 apps by class, each of 1 to 256 characters without control characters, or one regular expression of 1 to 256 characters without control characters that does not use a construct Hyprland's RE2 does not support (lookaround, backreferences or (?<name>) groups)
error.invalid-apps: Choose 1 to 32 apps; each window class has 1 to 256 characters without control characters
error.invalid-title: The title must have up to 256 characters without control characters; a regular expression must also not use a construct Hyprland's RE2 does not support (lookaround, backreferences or (?<name>) groups)
error.pattern-syntax: This pattern does not compile in this editor; Hyprland may still accept it
error.invalid-layout: The layout must be default, tile or float
error.invalid-size: Width and height must be whole numbers from 1 to 16384
error.invalid-position: X and Y must be whole numbers from 0 to 16384
error.invalid-monitor: The display must be given by its description
error.conflicting-effects: A rule cannot both make a window fullscreen and maximize it
error.file-unreadable: The rules file could not be read
error.file-too-large: The rules file is larger than 1 MiB
error.invalid-json: The rules file is not valid JSON
error.using-backup: The rules file could not be used, so Hyprland applied the last valid version from the backup
error.resolver-failed: The resolver failed to choose a workspace
error.resolver-missing: The resolver this rule uses is not registered
error.capability-missing: This Hyprland or Omarchy version lacks a function the loader needs for display slots and resolvers, so those targets are off; the other rules apply
error.capability-missing.static: This Hyprland or Omarchy version lacks the window rule function the loader needs, so no rule is registered
error.handler-failed: The loader failed while placing a window
error.register-failed: Hyprland refused to register this rule
error.unknown: The loader reported an unrecognized problem
warning.warn-geometry-not-floating: Size and position only apply to floating windows
warning.capture-position-clamped: The window was partly off its display; its position was moved inside it
warning.capture-workspace-unsupported: The window's workspace cannot be targeted; choose one
warning.warn-pattern-unchecked: A pattern uses RE2 flags this editor cannot check, such as (?U) or a flag group after the start; Hyprland checks it when the rules load
warning.warn-pattern-negative: A pattern starts with negative:, so it matches the windows the rest of the pattern does not match
state.conflict.kept: Your rule “%1” was kept. Reapply it to the current rules, or discard it.
summary.rules.hint: Rules that apply, of all the rules in the file
summary.dynamic.hint: Enabled rules that place windows by display slot or resolver
summary.moved.hint: Windows the loader moved since Hyprland last reloaded
summary.errors.hint: Problems the loader and the rules file reported
toggle.setSize.hint: Width and height of a floating window
toggle.enabled.hint: Off keeps the rule without applying it
toggle.pin.hint: Show a floating window on every workspace
preview.hint: Open windows this rule matches now; approximate, since Hyprland's RE2 and JavaScript differ in details
